stripped_sentences: a 1-0 away win over Ethiopia on a goal by Ibrahim Mbaye

failed_claims.claim: Senegal beat Ethiopia 1-0 away, Ibrahim Mbaye scoring, Patrick Vieira's first win as Senegal manager.
failed_claims.episode_span: a 1-0 away win over Ethiopia on a goal by Ibrahim Mbaye
failed_claims.supporting_quote: Senegal secured a 1-0 away victory against Ethiopia thanks to a goal from Ibrahim Mbaye.

claims.claim: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv carrying about 150 people transmitted a possible-hijacking distress signal on Wednesday, and Israel scrambled two fighter jets.
claims.episode_span: Israel scrambled two fighter jets to escort it, Ynetnews reports
claims.source_title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight reports suspected hijacking; Israeli fighter jets scrambled
claims.supporting_quote: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv carrying about 150 people briefly transmitted a distress signal indicating a possible hijacking Wednesday, prompting Israel to scramble two fighter jets to escort the aircraft.

claims.claim: The aircraft departed Dubai at 7:05 a.m. and was scheduled to land at Ben Gurion at about 9:30 a.m.
claims.episode_span: left Dubai at 7:05 a.m. and was scheduled into Ben Gurion Airport near Tel Aviv at about 9:30 a.m.
claims.source_title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight reports suspected hijacking; Israeli fighter jets scrambled
claims.supporting_quote: The Flydubai aircraft departed Dubai in the United Arab Emirates at 7:05 a.m. and had been scheduled to land at Ben Gurion Airport near Tel Aviv at about 9:30 a.m.

claims.claim: About 90 minutes into the flight, in Jordanian airspace, the aircraft transmitted squawk 7700 and then 7500, then turned back into Saudi airspace at lower altitude.
claims.episode_span: entering Jordanian airspace, it transmitted squawk code 7700, the general-emergency code, then code 7500
claims.source_title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight reports suspected hijacking; Israeli fighter jets scrambled
claims.supporting_quote: About 90 minutes into the flight, as the aircraft entered Jordanian airspace, it transmitted squawk code 7700, the international transponder code signaling a general emergency.

claims.claim: An Israeli security official said there was no definitive information of a hijacking and that the pilot activated a distress signal.
claims.episode_span: An Israeli security official said there was no definitive information of a hijacking
claims.source_title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight reports suspected hijacking; Israeli fighter jets scrambled
claims.supporting_quote: “There is no definitive information about a hijacking. The pilot activated a distress signal,” the official said.

claims.claim: Netanyahu and Katz convened an urgent security consultation.
claims.episode_span: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz convened an urgent security consultation.
claims.source_title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight reports suspected hijacking; Israeli fighter jets scrambled
claims.supporting_quote: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz convened an urgent security consultation following the incident.

claims.claim: UAE Super 98 petrol rises to Dh4.40 from Dh3.80 in October, a 15.7 percent increase, and diesel to Dh4.80 from Dh4.30.
claims.episode_span: Super 98 goes to Dh4.40 from Dh3.80, a 15.7 percent increase.
claims.source_title: UAE petrol prices to rise by about 16% in October
claims.supporting_quote: Super 98 will increase by 15.7 per cent, Special 95 by nearly 16 per cent, E-Plus 91 by 16.6 per cent and diesel by 11.6 per cent.

claims.claim: In September Brent neared $110 and WTI topped $105, and since early July Brent is up nearly 45 percent.
claims.episode_span: Brent neared $110 and West Texas Intermediate topped $105
claims.source_title: UAE petrol prices to rise by about 16% in October
claims.supporting_quote: Crude prices shot up again in September, with Brent nearing $110 and West Texas Intermediate topping $105 after the US and Iran resumed their offensives on each other, with the Strait of Hormuz remaining a flashpoint.

claims.claim: John Abdulai Jinapor cited commissioning of a 6,000-metric-ton LPG terminal and a first delivery by MT Asharami Ghana toward a 2030 goal of at least 50 percent LPG access.
claims.episode_span: commissioning of a 6,000-metric-ton LPG storage terminal and the first gas delivery by the vessel MT Asharami Ghana
claims.source_title: Ghana’s minister calls LPG investments key to 2030 target — MyJoyOnline
claims.supporting_quote: In a Facebook post, the minister said that the commissioning of a 6,000-metric-ton LPG storage terminal and the first gas delivery by MT Asharami Ghana demonstrate the importance of private investment for the development of the country’s gas infrastructure.

claims.claim: Tanzania removed Nigerian nationals from its referred visa category, ending special clearance before they can obtain visas.
claims.episode_span: Tanzania has removed Nigerian nationals from its referred visa category
claims.source_title: Tanzania: Tanzania Removes Special Visa Clearance for Nigerians
claims.supporting_quote: Tanzania has removed Nigerian nationals from its referred visa category, ending the requirement for special clearance before they can obtain visas to enter the country.

claims.claim: Abbas Araghchi received US feedback in Doha late Tuesday on a seven-day trust-building plan and will discuss it with Iranian leadership on Wednesday.
claims.episode_span: received US feedback in Doha late Tuesday, via Qatari mediators, on a seven-day trust-building plan
claims.source_title: Araghchi receives US feedback on trust-building plan, set to discuss with Iranian leadership
claims.supporting_quote: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Qatari mediators in Doha late on Tuesday and received US feedback on a proposed seven-day trust-building plan.

claims.claim: Burkina Faso launched its first gold refinery, and Mr Traore called it a historic milestone toward economic independence.
claims.episode_span: Burkina Faso has launched its first gold refinery
claims.source_title: Burkina Faso: Burkina Faso Launches First Gold Refinery
claims.supporting_quote: According to a statement by the Burkina Faso government's Information Service, Mr Traore said Burkina Faso has "reached a historic milestone in its quest for economic independence."

claims.claim: Ambassador Jimoh Ibrahim said at the UN on Tuesday that only total elimination of nuclear weapons guarantees against their use, and that Nigeria has no nuclear-weapons programme.
claims.episode_span: the only absolute guarantee against the use or threat of nuclear weapons is their total elimination
claims.source_title: Nigeria rejects nuclear deterrence, demands total elimination of atomic weapons
claims.supporting_quote: “Nigeria firmly believes that the only absolute guarantee against the use or threat of use of nuclear weapons is their total elimination,” Jimoh said.

claims.claim: Nigeria extended the 2025 capital budget to 31 December 2026, and Chijioke Ekechukwu said overlaps show a lack of fiscal discipline while revenue-to-GDP is less than 10 percent.
claims.episode_span: budget overlaps give the impression Nigeria is not a very serious country
claims.source_title: Chijioke Ekechukwu: Budget Overlaps Show Nigeria Is Not A Serious Country
claims.supporting_quote: “Budget overlaps gives an impression that we are not a very serious country. That’s actually what I think. Iit doesn’t show that there is any fiscal discipline that we have.”

claims.claim: Saudi Arabia resumed Yanbu loadings after the East-West Pipeline, shut on 11 September after drone attacks Riyadh attributed to Iraqi militias, restarted on 22 September.
claims.episode_span: resumed crude and refined-product loadings at the Red Sea port of Yanbu after restarting the East-West Pipeline
claims.source_title: Saudi Restarts Yanbu Oil Loadings After East-West Pipeline Reopens
claims.supporting_quote: The East-West Pipeline was shut on September 11 following drone attacks that Saudi Arabia attributed to Iraqi militias.

claims.claim: TankerTrackers, using ESA imagery from 27 September, indicated nearly 10 million barrels loading at Yanbu and Al Muajjiz, with throughput estimated near 2 million barrels a day by industry sources and 2.65 million by Kpler.
claims.episode_span: nearly 10 million barrels of crude being loaded at Yanbu and the nearby Al Muajjiz terminal
claims.source_title: Saudi Restarts Yanbu Oil Loadings After East-West Pipeline Reopens
claims.supporting_quote: European Space Agency (ESA) satellite imagery captured on September 27 indicated that nearly 10 million barrels (mmbbl) of crude were being loaded at Yanbu and the nearby Al Muajjiz terminal, according to vessel-tracking firm TankerTrackers.
